plans.idea: Classic left-to-right banner: brand at the far left, the headline block with its badges grouped underneath, then the phone, and the CTA closing the row at the right, each in its own column with clear gutters.

Keeps the original's structure turned sideways: one left-aligned column (logo, a one-line headline, subhead, then the CTA and badges together on one baseline), with the phone centered in its own right-hand panel the way it sits in the source.
Three zones: the phone anchors the left edge, the headline, subhead and badges fill the center, and a right-hand column stacks the brand above the action so logo and CTA both have room around them.
